visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee and a red baseball cap is seen in a close-up selfie shot, speaking directly to the camera. He wears a black t-shirt with a green graphic logo. Behind him is a bright, partly cloudy blue sky. (2) The scene transitions to a medium long shot of a grand, yellow historic palace with a dark blue roof and French flags flying atop. Several small figures of tourists walk across the large paved foreground. (3) The camera pans across another ornate, dark stone building with complex architectural details and statues. It then cuts to various construction sites showing metal scaffolding and green protective mesh covering parts of building facades. (4) The man returns in a selfie view, pointing toward the Belvedere Palace in the background. A visual effect splits the screen, comparing the original stone facade with the renovation areas covered in incredibly realistic printed canvases that mimic the building's architecture. (5) Close-up shots highlight the quality of these printed canvases, showing how they align perfectly with the real windows and ornaments of the palace. (6) Final shot returns to the man in the initial outdoor setting, smiling and waving goodbye to the camera.
